BiblicalUsage: Shenazzar is the son of Jeconiah. He is named in the genealogy of the captive king of Judah, one of the sons of the line carried to Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a son of a captive king is still a son of the line, and Shenazzar's name keeps the promise alive in Babylon.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
